parsed.name: 是德科技示波器
parsed.description: 台式电子示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电信号随时间变化的波形。常用于实验室中观察电压波形、测量频率、周期、上升沿、下降沿、占空比、脉宽、过冲及峰峰值等参数，并可导出波形数据和屏幕截图；部分机型还支持数字电压表功能。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop electronic oscilloscope used to acquire, display, and analyze electrical waveforms over time. It is commonly used in laboratories to observe voltage signals and measure frequency, period, rise time, fall time, duty cycle, pulse width, overshoot, and peak-to-peak voltage, and can export waveform data and screen images; some models also support digital voltmeter functions.
